detailed_description:
PAGA/扩散拟时序/scVelo RNA velocity/CellRank命运映射。从scanpy输出链接

适用场景: development, regeneration, differentiation

分析步骤:
  - Monocle3 trajectory: learn_graph+order_cells
  - RNA velocity (scVelo): latent_time inference
  - Branch point detection: Branch DE genes
  - CellRank endstates: GPCCA initial/terminal
  - Trajectory visualization: UMAP + trajectory overlay

依赖包: SeuratWrappers, scanpy, cellrank, scvelo, monocle3

难度: advanced

触发提示: "进行轨迹推断分析"

别名: 轨迹推断 (PAGA/scVelo/CellRank)

errors.message: Error in unique(): Must provide a graph object (provided wrong object type) | clusters() was deprecated in igraph 2.0.0
errors.root_cause: attach igraph(2.0+) 后 igraph::clusters 遮蔽 monocle3::clusters，monocle3 的 partitions()/clusters() 内部解析到 igraph 版本，收到 cds 对象即报错
errors.fix_applied: 从脚本中移除 library(igraph)（只用 igraph:: 前缀调用），避免 igraph::clusters() 遮蔽 monocle3::clusters() 导致 partitions()/clusters() 内部报错

errors.message: Must group by variables found in `.data`. Column `cohort`/`donor`/`timepoint` is not found (dplyr::group_by on merged subset)
errors.root_cause: 跨嵌入比较用的 merge 只挑了部分列，后续按 cohort/donor/timepoint 分组时列不存在
errors.fix_applied: merge 时把 donor/timepoint/cohort 列一起带进 m（原来只选了 cell/pseudotime/celltype/samplename），再重跑 traj_09

errors.message: 错误于pseudotime(cds4): No pseudotime calculated for reduction_method = UMAP. Please first run order_cells with reduction_method = UMAP.
errors.root_cause: step1 脚本把 saveRDS(cds_graph.rds) 放在 order_cells 之前 → 落盘的 CDS 只有图骨架没有伪时间槽，后续脚本直接 pseudotime() 报错。
errors.fix_applied: cds_graph.rds 是在 learn_graph 之后、order_cells 之前保存的（step1 脚本保存点位置错误），因此加载后没有 pseudotime 槽。修复：读入后判断 principal_graph_aux[["UMAP"]]$pseudotime 是否为空，空则先 order_cells(cds, root_pr_nodes="Y_109")。教训：CDS 落盘点必须放
